data.long_meaning: Jadessia is a Hebrew name derived from the Hebrew word ‘Yada’, meaning ‘to know’. It is a feminine form of the name Jadon, which means ‘God knows’. In the Bible, the name Jadessia can be associated with God’s all-knowing nature. It implies a deep understanding and awareness of the divine. The name Jadessia carries the meaning “God's knowledge, wisdom” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Jadessia usually hope their child will grow to embody god's knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes knowledge and wisdom from God.
data.etymology: Jadessia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's knowledge, wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jadessia total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: יעדסיה
in_hebrew.meaning: אבן יקרה, חסד אלוהים, רצון אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יעדסיה הוא שילוב של המילים העבריות 'יעד' ו'אליה' או 'אלוהים', שפירושן 'אבן יקרה' או 'חסד אלוהים'. הוא קשור לנושא הרצון האלוהי או האבן הנבחרת על ידי אלוהים. השם נושא משמעות עמוקה של קשר רוחני ואלוהי.

in_greek.name: Ιαδεσία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιαδεσία προέρχεται από εβραϊκές ρίζες και σχετίζεται με έννοιες όπως 'Χάρις Θεοῦ' (Χάρις του Θεού) ή 'Προνοία Θεοῦ'. Στην πνευματική παράδοση, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει την εύνοια και την πρόνοια του Θεού. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοιες ονομασίες συνδέονται με την έννοια της θεϊκής εύνοιας και προστασίας.

in_latin.name: Iadessia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Iadessia originem habet hebraicam et significationem habet quae ad 'Dei Voluntas' vel 'Gratia Dei' pertinet. In traditione christiana, hoc nomen habet profundam connotationem spiritualem et divinam, significans electionem et gratiam divinam.
